scripts.dev: npm run media:video:build && npm run media:build && vite
scripts.build: npm run media:video:build && npm run media:build && npm run typecheck && vite build && npm run site:postbuild
scripts.site:postbuild: node tools/generate-sitemap.mjs && node tools/check-site-meta.mjs && node tools/check-local-links.mjs

scripts.test:media: npm run media:video:build && npm run media:build && node --test "test/media-tools/*.test.mjs" && node tools/check-data-integrity.ts
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:e2e:cv
